title: Publishing a translation: its gates, the serving rule and the AI-translation label
description: As an editor, I want to publish a saved translation like any Story, with the translation's own gates, so a held or orphaned translation never goes live and every translated page says what it is. Shipped in PR #1518: a translation's checklist is its provenance; a held translation publishes only after a person answers its review request; it publishes and is served only while its original is published; no rating of its own; the label (interface strings translation.label and translation.original), JSON-LD translationOfWork and Markdown twin facts; its own address and pictures at first save; no new-story announcements. Spec: features_backend/translation-publishing.feature. Doc: docs/story-translation-procedure.md, Publishing a translation.
